'''Khandrex''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3636 BBY]] he was on [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]] when former Sith Emperor [[Tenebrae|Vitiate]] came to the world and possessed many of the Imperials on the planet, turning them into his puppets to [[Death/Legends|murder]] civilians. Khandrex was among those who fell under his control and he was killed during the fighting.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lord Khandrex was added to ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' in game update 3.2.
